# OB Club

> A private, global network for online founders, builders, and operators. OB Club runs on three things: curated in-person events, an active community, and real partnerships between members. Founded 2026, with flagship events in Riga and members building worldwide.

## What OB Club is
- A free-to-join private community for entrepreneurs, freelancers, and operators who are actually building online businesses, agencies, and product companies. The bar is ambition and follow-through, not revenue.
- Curated, intentionally small events: private founder dinners and operator roundtables where every seat matters.
- Behind the Business: a podcast breaking down real founder stories into the lessons that move a business, each episode paired with in-depth written articles.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://obclub.co/): what OB Club is, who it's for, and how to join.
- [Events](https://obclub.co/events): private dinners, roundtables, and socials.
- [Podcast](https://obclub.co/podcast): Behind the Business episodes and their article breakdowns.
- [Partners](https://obclub.co/partners): for brands that want to reach the community.
- [Contact](https://obclub.co/contact): join the free community or start a partnership.

## How to join
The community is free. Members start in the WhatsApp group, then get invited to events as they get involved. Partnerships and premium events are handled case by case.
